title: CmdPal: Keep Command Palette hosts open during owned operations

proposed_comments.title: Preserve dock-owned dismissal holds (1/2)
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve dock-owned dismissal holds (1/2)

**Severity:** `medium`

Keep the explicit flyout close, but leave dismissal holds owned by the dock intact. Switching flyout pages can otherwise erase an in-flight command’s hold on the same HWND and let the dock auto-hide before the command finishes.

```suggestion

        // The dock HWND outlives this flyout.
```

Apply both suggestions as a batch.

confidence.rationale: Both callbacks reset the entire dock HWND bucket, which also holds routed command tokens. Dock teardown owns the cleanup.
